draft.emotion: wide open and expressive, pointing out something impressive in size
notes: Grande shortens to gran before masculine and feminine nouns starting with a consonant, except s- impure, z, x, gn, ps (e.g., gran casa, gran donna, but grande studente).
When placed before a noun, grande often means 'great' or 'wonderful'; when placed after, it usually means 'big' or 'large' in physical size.
